column3: Re-derives proofs/libreac/fuzz_disco/lib/Reusable/YB03.v and YB01.v from dumps/ (or from the collector logs, when given), the released donor headers and the image B pin, then compares both and YB01.v.json byte for byte.

Writes the per-value extract of a start-up collector log: only the printed results hsform.py reads (JSDUMP of pass 1; HSDUMPHOLES and HSDUMP of pass 2), after cutting the timing lines a timed build splices in; with --part-bytes it writes the extract in line-cut parts. Its header names the log's sha256.

Extract of the pass-1 collector log (sha256 424370879446, 55492 bytes): the join state the donor checker printed on image B. hsform.py js reads it for YB03.v. The log itself is a build log and is not shipped; the collector drivers were never committed, so the log is re-derivable only by a collector run on a build machine.

First part of the extract of the pass-2 collector log (sha256 8331d9ec8f44, 5997149 bytes), cut at a line end under the repository's 5 MiB file cap; `cat pass2.dump.00 pass2.dump.01` is the extract. The extract holds the hole list and the 220 leaves of both arms of every mmap node, with the 50 hand-off states. hsform.py hs reads it for YB01.v; ad2/ reads it for YD2i.v, YD2j.v and YD1k.v. Re-derivable only by a collector run on a build machine (see pass1.dump).
Second part of the extract of the pass-2 collector log; see pass2.dump.00.

Forms the join state (YB03.v) and the 50 hand-off states (YB01.v) from the collector's printed results, with the pin, KImg and descriptor-array gates. Start-up tool set 2026-10-29 copy sha256 a93ebaea058f with two comment lines reworded and no code changed.
Module hsform.py imports: the image memory reader and the descriptor-array reader (Mem, state_bytes, descriptors), cut verbatim from the start-up set's af0m.py sha256 238598b380f1.

Module hsform.py imports: the pinned-original gate (the image's sha256 must be a row of the index OSSV_BINARIES_TSV names), cut from the start-up set's pins.py sha256 4778073f01be without its fallbacks to host locations.
Rewrites the donor module paths to the unit's and adds the one Modified line; turns the hsform outputs into the shipped YB03.v and YB01.v.
hsform's per-hole record of the 50 hand-off states (50 reached, 0 filled, the knowledge-list lengths and shared-prefix bases); run.sh regenerates it byte for byte.
